using namespace std;

const int MAXN = 250005;
int n, k, mod, answer;
int highestPower[MAXN], factorial[MAXN], invFactorial[MAXN], dp[27][MAXN];

int modPow(int base, int exp) {
    int result = 1;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (1LL * result * base) % mod;
        base = (1LL * base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    scanf("%d %d %d", &n, &k, &mod);
    
    invFactorial[0] = invFactorial[1] = factorial[0] = 1;
    
    for (int i = 2; i <= n; ++i) {
        invFactorial[i] = 1LL * (mod - mod / i) * invFactorial[mod % i] % mod;
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i <<= 1) {
        for (int j = i >> 1; j < i && j <= n; ++j) {
            highestPower[j] = i;
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
        factorial[i] = 1LL * factorial[i-1] * i % mod;
        invFactorial[i] = 1LL * invFactorial[i-1] * invFactorial[i] % mod;
    }
    
    answer = modPow(k, n);
    
    if (n % 2 == 0) {
        dp[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 26; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= n; ++j) {
                if (dp[i][j] && (j & n) == j) {
                    for (int next = j + highestPower[j]; next <= n; next = (next + 1) | j) {
                        if ((next & n) == next) {
                            dp[i+1][next] = (dp[i+1][next] + 1LL * dp[i][j] * invFactorial[next - j] % mod) % mod;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        int temp = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 26; ++i) {
            temp = (temp + 1LL * dp[i][n] * invFactorial[k - i] % mod) % mod;
        }
        answer = (answer - 1LL * temp * factorial[n] % mod * factorial[k] % mod + mod) % mod;
    }
    
    printf("%d", answer);
    return 0;
}
